::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
Top border colour = school of magic. **C** = Concentration · **R** = Ritual · ⭐ = Prepared
:::

## Level 1

```{=html}
<div class="spell-grid">

  <div class="spell-card sc-enchantment">
    <div class="spell-header"><span class="spell-name">Command</span><span class="spell-level-badge">1st Level</span></div>
    <div class="spell-school">Enchantment · Cleric (Acolyte)</div>
    <div class="spell-stats">
      <span><b>Cast:</b> Action</span><span><b>Range:</b> 60 ft</span>
      <span><b>Comp:</b> V</span><span><b>Dur:</b> 1 round</span>
    </div>
    <div class="spell-desc"><b>WIS save</b> or obey a one-word command on their next turn. Examples: <em>Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel, Halt.</em> No effect on undead or creatures that don't understand the language.</div>
    <div class="spell-upcast">↑ +1 extra target per slot level above 1st</div>
    <div class="spell-source">Acolyte background (Cleric)</div>
  </div>

    <div class="spell-header"><span class="spell-name">Magic Missile</span><span class="spell-level-badge">1st Level</span></div>

      <span><b>Cast:</b> Action</span><span><b>Range:</b> 120 ft</span>
      <span><b>Comp:</b> V, S</span><span><b>Dur:</b> Instant</span>
    </div>
    <div class="spell-desc">Create <b>3 darts</b> of magical force, each dealing <b>1d4 + 1</b> damage. <b>Auto-hit</b> — no attack roll. Can split between targets freely. Each dart hits individually.</div>
    <div class="spell-upcast">↑ +1 dart per slot level above 1st (4 darts @ 2nd, 5 @ 3rd…)</div>
    <div class="spell-source">Wizard spellbook</div>

    <div class="spell-school">Abjuration · Wizard</div>
    <div class="spell-stats">
      <span><b>Cast:</b> Action</span><span><b>Range:</b> Touch</span>
      <span><b>Comp:</b> V, S, M (leather)</span><span><b>Dur:</b> 8 hours</span>
    </div>
    <div class="spell-desc">Surround the target with protective magical force. Target's AC becomes <b>13 + DEX modifier</b> (currently <b>AC 15</b> for Tiberius). Only works if target wears <b>no armour</b>. Ends if they don armour.</div>
    <div class="spell-source">Wizard spellbook · Cast daily at start of day</div>
  </div>

    <div class="spell-header"><span class="spell-name">Grease</span><span class="spell-level-badge">1st Level</span></div>

    <div class="spell-stats">
      <span><b>Cast:</b> Action</span><span><b>Range:</b> 60 ft</span>
      <span><b>Comp:</b> V, S, M (butter)</span><span><b>Dur:</b> 1 min</span>
    </div>
    <div class="spell-desc">A <b>10-ft square</b> becomes <b>difficult terrain</b>. Each creature in the area on cast: <b>DEX save</b> or fall <b>Prone</b>. Same save when entering or ending a turn there.</div>
    <div class="spell-source">Magic Initiate (Cleric)</div>
  </div>

  <div class="spell-card sc-conjuration">
    <div class="spell-header"><span class="spell-name">Unseen Servant</span><span class="spell-level-badge">1st Level</span></div>

      <span><b>Cast:</b> Action / Ritual +10 min</span><span><b>Range:</b> 60 ft</span>
      <span><b>Comp:</b> V, S, M</span><span><b>Dur:</b> 1 hour</span>
    </div>
    <div class="spell-desc">Invisible mindless servant (STR 2, AC 10, 1 HP). Carries ≤ 25 lbs. Performs simple tasks: open doors, carry items, clean, pour drinks. Disappears at 0 HP.</div>
    <div class="spell-source">Wizard spellbook (ritual — no slot needed)</div>
  </div>

  <div class="spell-card sc-conjuration">
    <div class="spell-header"><span class="spell-name">Find Familiar</span><span class="spell-level-badge">1st Level</span></div>

      <span><b>Comp:</b> V, S, M (10 gp consumed)</span><span><b>Dur:</b> Until dismissed</span>
    </div>
    <div class="spell-desc">Summon a spirit in animal form (bat, cat, crab, frog, hawk, lizard, octopus, owl, rat, raven, sea horse, spider, weasel). Share senses as a Bonus Action. Deliver touch spells through familiar. Reappears after 0 HP with re-casting.</div>
    <div class="spell-source">Wizard spellbook (ritual — no slot needed)</div>
  </div>

    <div class="spell-header"><span class="spell-name">Comprehend Languages</span><span class="spell-level-badge">1st Level</span></div>

      <span><b>Cast:</b> Action / Ritual +10 min</span><span><b>Range:</b> Self</span>

    </div>
    <div class="spell-desc">Understand any <b>spoken language</b> you hear. Understand any <b>written language</b> you see (must touch surface; 1 min/page). Does not grant ability to speak the language.</div>
    <div class="spell-source">Wizard spellbook (ritual — no slot needed)</div>
  </div>

  <div class="spell-card sc-conjuration">
    <div class="spell-header"><span class="spell-name">Tenser's Floating Disk</span><span class="spell-level-badge">1st Level</span></div>
    <div class="spell-school">Conjuration · Wizard</div>
    <div class="spell-tags"><span class="spell-tag ritual">Ritual</span></div>
    <div class="spell-stats">
      <span><b>Cast:</b> Action / Ritual +10 min</span><span><b>Range:</b> 30 ft</span>
      <span><b>Comp:</b> V, S, M</span><span><b>Dur:</b> 1 hour</span>
    </div>
    <div class="spell-desc">3-ft wide disk of force hovering 1 ft off the ground. Carries up to <b>500 lbs</b>. Follows you within 20 ft automatically. Stays put if you move farther. Vanishes if you are more than 100 ft away.</div>
    <div class="spell-source">Wizard spellbook (ritual — no slot needed)</div>
  </div>

  <div class="spell-card sc-illusion">
    <div class="spell-header"><span class="spell-name">Silent Image</span><span class="spell-level-badge">1st (cast @ 2nd slot)</span></div>
    <div class="spell-school">Illusion · Wizard</div>
    <div class="spell-tags"><span class="spell-tag conc">C</span></div>
    <div class="spell-stats">
      <span><b>Cast:</b> Action</span><span><b>Range:</b> 60 ft</span>
      <span><b>Comp:</b> V, S, M (fleece)</span><span><b>Dur:</b> Conc., 10 min</span>
    </div>
    <div class="spell-desc">Create a <b>15-ft cube</b> visual illusion (no sound, smell, or texture). Creatures that interact and succeed on Investigation vs <b>DC 13</b> see through it. Use an Action to move it up to 20 ft.</div>
    <div class="spell-upcast">Requires a 2nd-level slot to cast</div>
    <div class="spell-source">Wizard spellbook</div>
  </div>

  <div class="spell-card sc-enchantment">
    <div class="spell-header"><span class="spell-name">Silvery Barbs</span><span class="spell-level-badge">1st (cast @ 2nd slot)</span></div>
    <div class="spell-school">Enchantment · Wizard</div>
    <div class="spell-tags"><span class="spell-tag react">Reaction</span></div>
    <div class="spell-stats">
      <span><b>Cast:</b> <b>Reaction</b></span><span><b>Range:</b> 60 ft</span>
      <span><b>Comp:</b> V</span><span><b>Dur:</b> Instant</span>
    </div>
    <div class="spell-desc"><b>Trigger:</b> a creature within 60 ft succeeds on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw.<br><b>Effect:</b> that roll becomes a <b>failure</b>. Then choose a different creature you can see — it gains <b>advantage</b> on its next d20 roll (attack, check, or save).</div>
    <div class="spell-upcast">Requires a 2nd-level slot to cast</div>
    <div class="spell-source">Wizard spellbook</div>
  </div>

  <div class="spell-card sc-illusion">
    <div class="spell-header"><span class="spell-name">Color Spray</span><span class="spell-level-badge">1st (cast @ 3rd slot)</span></div>

    <div class="spell-upcast">↑ +2d10 HP worth per slot above 1st. Requires 3rd-level slot.</div>
```

## Level 2

```{=html}
<div class="spell-grid">

  <div class="spell-card sc-transmutation">
    <div class="spell-header"><span class="spell-name">Magic Weapon</span><span class="spell-level-badge">2nd (cast @ 3rd slot)</span></div>
    <div class="spell-school">Transmutation · Wizard</div>
    <div class="spell-tags"><span class="spell-tag conc">C</span></div>
    <div class="spell-stats">
      <span><b>Cast:</b> Bonus Action</span><span><b>Range:</b> Touch</span>
      <span><b>Comp:</b> V, S</span><span><b>Dur:</b> Conc., 1 hour</span>
    </div>
    <div class="spell-desc">A nonmagical weapon becomes magical with <b>+1 bonus</b> to attack rolls and damage rolls. Bypasses resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks.</div>
    <div class="spell-upcast">↑ +2 bonus @ 4th-level slot · +3 bonus @ 6th-level slot. Requires 3rd-level slot.</div>
    <div class="spell-source">Wizard spellbook</div>
  </div>

  <div class="spell-card sc-illusion">
    <div class="spell-header"><span class="spell-name">Nystul's Magic Aura</span><span class="spell-level-badge">2nd Level</span></div>
    <div class="spell-school">Illusion · Wizard (Illusionist)</div>
    <div class="spell-stats">
      <span><b>Cast:</b> Action</span><span><b>Range:</b> Touch</span>
      <span><b>Comp:</b> V, S, M (tiny square of silk)</span><span><b>Dur:</b> 24 hours</span>
    </div>
    <div class="spell-desc">Alter one creature or object's magical aura detected by spells. Choose two effects: (1) <b>False Aura</b> — make nonmagical appear magical or vice versa, choose school; (2) <b>Mask</b> — change apparent creature type for divinations. Lasts 30 days if cast daily for 30 days.</div>
    <div class="spell-source">Wizard spellbook (Illusionist)</div>
  </div>

  <div class="spell-card sc-illusion">
    <div class="spell-header"><span class="spell-name">Invisibility</span><span class="spell-level-badge">2nd Level</span></div>
    <div class="spell-school">Illusion · Wizard (Illusionist)</div>
    <div class="spell-tags"><span class="spell-tag conc">C</span></div>
    <div class="spell-stats">
      <span><b>Cast:</b> Action</span><span><b>Range:</b> Touch</span>
      <span><b>Comp:</b> V, S, M (eyelash in gum arabic)</span><span><b>Dur:</b> Conc., 1 hour</span>
    </div>
    <div class="spell-desc">Target becomes <b>Invisible</b>. Everything worn or carried is also invisible. Ends <b>immediately</b> if target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.</div>
    <div class="spell-upcast">↑ +1 additional target per slot above 2nd</div>
    <div class="spell-source">Wizard spellbook (Illusionist)</div>
  </div>

  <div class="spell-card sc-transmutation">
    <div class="spell-header"><span class="spell-name">Rope Trick</span><span class="spell-level-badge">2nd (cast @ 3rd — Slot B)</span></div>
    <div class="spell-school">Transmutation · Wizard</div>
    <div class="spell-stats">
      <span><b>Cast:</b> Action</span><span><b>Range:</b> Touch</span>
      <span><b>Comp:</b> V, S, M (powdered corn)</span><span><b>Dur:</b> 1 hour</span>
    </div>
    <div class="spell-desc">A rope rises vertically to 60 ft. The top opens to an <b>extradimensional space</b> large enough for up to 8 Medium creatures. The entrance is <b>invisible from outside</b>. Creatures inside can see out as through a 3-ft × 5-ft window. Rope can be pulled in. Everyone exits when spell ends.</div>
    <div class="spell-upcast">Requires 3rd-level slot (Slot B)</div>
    <div class="spell-source">Wizard spellbook</div>
  </div>

</div>
```

## Ranger Spells

```{=html}
<div class="spell-grid">

  <div class="spell-card sc-divination">
    <div class="spell-header"><span class="spell-name">Hunter's Mark ⭐</span><span class="spell-level-badge">1st Level · ALWAYS PREPARED</span></div>
    <div class="spell-school">Divination · Ranger · <em>Favored Enemy: 1/day free cast</em></div>
    <div class="spell-tags"><span class="spell-tag conc">C</span></div>
    <div class="spell-stats">
      <span><b>Cast:</b> Bonus Action</span><span><b>Range:</b> 90 ft</span>
      <span><b>Comp:</b> V</span><span><b>Dur:</b> Conc., 1 hr (24 hr @ 3rd, 8 hr @ 5th)</span>
    </div>
    <div class="spell-desc">Choose a creature you can see within range — it becomes your quarry. You deal an extra <b>1d6</b> damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack roll. If the target dies, you can move the mark to a new creature as a <b>Bonus Action</b>. Requires concentration.<br><br>⭐ <b>Favored Enemy (Hobgoblin):</b> always prepared; cast <b>1/day without a spell slot</b>.</div>
    <div class="spell-upcast">↑ 3rd slot: Conc. up to 24 hrs · 5th slot: Conc. up to 8 hrs</div>
    <div class="spell-source">Ranger spell · WIS DC 11 · +3 attack</div>
  </div>

  <div class="spell-card sc-abjuration">
    <div class="spell-header"><span class="spell-name">Cure Wounds ⭐</span><span class="spell-level-badge">1st Level · PREPARED</span></div>
    <div class="spell-school">Abjuration · Ranger</div>
    <div class="spell-stats">
      <span><b>Cast:</b> Action</span><span><b>Range:</b> Touch</span>
      <span><b>Comp:</b> V, S</span><span><b>Dur:</b> Instant</span>
    </div>
    <div class="spell-desc">A creature you touch regains <b>2d8 + WIS modifier</b> Hit Points. Has no effect on Undead or Constructs.</div>
    <div class="spell-upcast">↑ +2d8 per slot level above 1st (4d8+WIS @ 2nd · 6d8+WIS @ 3rd…)</div>
    <div class="spell-source">Ranger spell · WIS DC 11</div>
  </div>

</div>
```
